Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

jobs.jd:
As a strategy and management consultancy, we work together with industry leaders in the Automotive & Transport, Energy & Environment, and Public & Infrastructure sectors to shape the mobility and energy ecosystem of the future. We use the tools of digital transformation to lead long‑established companies into the future and to help young companies establish themselves in the market.

Since we started in 2017, we have grown to over 110 employees across seven locations – Berlin, Munich, Vienna, Cologne, Hamburg, Bucharest, and, more recently, Warsaw. Thanks to our subsidiary &amp and its 50+ developers, we are able to deliver end‑to‑end solutions in particularly close collaboration. We are proud to have been listed for the seventh consecutive time among the Top Ten of the brand eins/Statista “Best Consultants” ranking and to have been honored with the prestigious “Hidden Champion 2026/2027” award.

 

What to Expect 

With us, you will help build something big – at the heart of the digital transformation of the automotive industry. We work closely with decision-makers at C-level and design complex strategic programs from concept to implementation. We foster an open team culture, flat hierarchies, and the highest level of professionalism, always meeting on equal footing. 
 

We work in a practice-based organization that allows our consultants, starting at Senior Consultant level, to align with a clearly defined area of expertise.
